dict.string: Anticipy listens for ambient conversational intent. Microphone access is required for the product to work.
Anticipy reads on-screen text when you ask it to act on what you are looking at. Screen access stays local to your Mac.
Anticipy uses AppleScript to drive Mail, Calendar, and Messages on your behalf when you confirm an action.
Anticipy listens for the hotkey to open the popover. No keystrokes are recorded or sent off device.
Anticipy reads your calendar to answer questions and create events when you approve them.
Anticipy reads your contacts to resolve names when you ask it to message or call someone.
Anticipy creates reminders when you ask it to follow up later.
